_comment: The 60-second walkthrough, as data. Every clip names the PNG the app's own renderer produced, the sha256 prefix that identifies that exact render, the seconds it holds, and the caption burned into the frame. build.mjs re-hashes each PNG and refuses to cut a frame it cannot identify -- a demo video is the easiest place in this project to accidentally show something that never ran.
